description: Load and capture Lockley's local cross-agent memory.

hooks.command: lockley_root="$PWD"; while [ "$lockley_root" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$lockley_root/scripts/agent-memory.cjs" ]; do lockley_root=$(dirname "$lockley_root"); done; node "$lockley_root/scripts/agent-memory.cjs" hook codex
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$payload = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $lockleyRoot = (Get-Location).Path; while ($lockleyRoot -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $lockleyRoot 'scripts/agent-memory.cjs'))) { $parent = Split-Path -Parent $lockleyRoot; if ($parent -eq $lockleyRoot) { exit 0 }; $lockleyRoot = $parent }; $payload | & node (Join-Path $lockleyRoot 'scripts/agent-memory.cjs') hook codex"
